payload.authorization: User-authorized split-first zero-oracle Gate 3-4 milestone following immutable complete-region runtime Gates 1-2.
payload.scientific_problem: Learn a source-conditioned distribution over one to four complete address-free dependency-region target patches without decoding executor primitive traces.
payload.primary_output: A target-independent runtime checkpoint that generates CompleteRegionProgram decisions containing whole StructuralSubgoal patches and explicit CONTINUE/STOP control.
payload.claim_under_test: A split-first conditional graph-delta grammar can support held-source teacher patches and autonomously generate valid complete protected programs through the sealed exact runtime.
payload.validation_setting: Three frozen whole-source folds over the 77 T4 routes and 147 complete regions, CPU-only, zero-oracle teacher-forced diagnostics and autonomous matched-budget generation.

generated_object.decision: one whole address-free StructuralSubgoal target patch
generated_object.factorization: WHERE source-role set, then one conditional canonical graph-delta token stream jointly encoding survival/deletion, output roles, atom attributes, target topology/bond attributes, boundary attachments and within-patch dependencies, then CONTINUE/STOP
generated_object.cross_region_created_role_learning: abstain when the training fold has no positive CreatedRoleReference example; runtime capability remains unchanged

policy.architecture: source-balanced conditional categorical graph-delta decoder with additive smoothing and legality masks
policy.learned: context-conditioned canonical token probabilities fit on training-fold complete patches
policy.balancing: equal source mass, within source equal route mass, within route equal region/token mass
policy.teacher_injection: Gate 3 diagnostic only and always labelled separately

gate0_support.action_on_failure: stop before fitting and publish missing token/context support

gate3.comparison: learned versus same-grammar source-balanced marginal control at 128 candidates

prohibitions: Do not modify immutable Gate 1-2 artifacts.
Do not decode 5-32 executor primitive actions.
Do not fit or tune a selector, value model, Dynamic-v0 controller, compiler or scoring function.
Do not use held-source records to derive a vocabulary, statistic, condition, negative or candidate policy.
Do not call an oracle or docking function, launch Modal, use the network or access a live run.
Do not relax gates after inspecting results.
